name: SplatterVault
summary:
**Your SplatterVault command center, built for Quest.**

SplatterVault is a companion app that gives you full control over your on-demand dedicated game servers without leaving VR. Designed for Seamless Multitasking, it runs as a 2D panel alongside your favorite VR games.

**Features:**
- Launch and manage dedicated game servers in seconds
- Track your credit balance and session usage in real time
